lessons.text: Never use appeal to ignorance (Treating the absence of disproof as proof (or the reverse)). It cost you against Maimonides.

Prepare an answer before you assert: Maimonides broke through with "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the premise survives test…" (Clean argument. structure=0.50, evidence=1.00).

Borrow this pattern from Maimonides: "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the premise survives test…" — it answered the opponent directly, it carried evidence, its premises led cleanly to the conclusion.
